scope: Public bootstrap and named current public source entries, not complete CoAll history or a global chat census
time_rule: An old event discovered today retains its original event_at if independently sourced; missing clocks stay null; no inferred chronological precision.

historical_echo_rule.capture: Collect source pointer, original event identity, parent work-id, privacy class, provenance, digest if exact bytes are available, and explicit unknowns.
historical_echo_rule.echo: Attach candidate relevance to current CoFront without overwriting original meaning, challenge, dissent, or past status.
historical_echo_rule.compare: Compare against current descendant using claimed need, actual accepted effects, and remaining unsatisfied needs. Newest-wins prohibited.
historical_echo_rule.recovery: Choose one of dispositions with exact successor or retirement evidence; unresolved means ORPHAN_RISK, never silently dropped.
historical_echo_rule.predictive_retro: Counterfactuals are labeled simulations, not facts about past or future. Assess how earlier warning signs could have affected next-proof scheduling.
historical_echo_rule.privacy: No session transcripts, private mail, unpublished collaborations, credentials, or private source locators in public projection.

gaps.reason: No complete earliest-to-latest CoAll source census or bounded coverage manifest
No authorized global enumeration of historical sessions
Independent local/private receiver and exact readproof unavailable in this pass
Prior bounded Library index observed subset with traversal-limit warning; private source pointers not published
Public GitHub retrieval is not another agent's pickup or semantic integration

acceptance: A second reader reconstructs each public anchor from its exact repo path and commit.
An earlier source with changed interpretation stays recoverable; no silent supersession.
A missing source produces UNKNOWN_OR_ORPHAN_RISK, never PASS.
At least one prior historical object can be linked to a descendant using evidence not naming coincidence.
Public output exposes no private identifiers or session transcripts.
At least one independent receiver reports exact-object readproof before claiming pickup.
